rule: discount_pct is not null (missing is not assumed to be 0)
all other required columns are not null
column: order_id, customer_segment, category, quantity, unit_price, payment_status

rule: ISO-formatted order_date is a real date between 2025-01-01 and today
category is one of the 3 allowed products
segment and payment_status map to an allowed value after normalization
each category has a single unit_price
newest order is at most 2 days old
